entities.name: Mistmeadow
entities.description: A kithkin doun on Shadowmoor, the counterpart of Goldmeadow, with tall spiked walls.

entities.name: Molla Welk
entities.description: Cenn who led Mistmeadow in 4520 AR.

entities.name: Jack Chierdagh
entities.description: Mistmeadow's protector, the Hero of Mistmeadow.

entities.name: Rosheen Meanderer
entities.description: Giant whose rampage Jack drove away from the doun.

entities.name: Ashling the Destroyer
entities.description: Attacked Mistmeadow; repelled by Eidren's sacrifice.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: Led a shapewater brigade that limited the damage to Mistmeadow.

entities.name: Vigilant Eidren
entities.description: Wilt-Leaf Vigilant who sacrificed himself to hurl Ashling away.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Faerie queen whose defeat preceded Mistmeadow's brief return to its Lorwyn form.

events.summary: Jack Chierdagh becomes the Hero of Mistmeadow by driving Rosheen Meanderer's rampage away.
events.quote: Jack became the Mistmeadow hero when he completed the task to drive

events.summary: Ashling the Destroyer attacks Mistmeadow; Brigid Baeli's brigade limits the damage.
events.quote: Mistmeadow was attacked by Ashling the Destroyer

events.summary: Vigilant Eidren sacrifices himself, channeling forest magic to hurl Ashling from the doun.
events.quote: who channeled forest magic through his body to hurl her away

events.summary: Following Oona's defeat, Mistmeadow briefly returns to its Goldmeadow form around 4564 AR.
events.quote: it made a brief return around 4564 AR

relations.note: Cenn of the doun in 4520 AR.
relations.quote: the doun was led by cenn Molla Welk
